chosen_titles.rationale: M.G.L. c. 3 (General Court / legislative branch) sits in chapters 1-182, which is Part I (Administration of the Government); chapter 3 houses the lobbying-disclosure regime at sections 39-50.

notes: MA Justia structure: Part -> Title -> Chapter -> Section. Lobbying disclosure (M.G.L. c. 3 ss. 39-50) lives in Part I.
